#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>

int main() {
    int length;
    std::cin >> length;
    int maxSegment = 0;
    int wordsCount = 0;
    std::string data;
    std::cin >> data;

    bool insideParentheses = false;
    int segmentSize = 0;
    int tempSegmentSize = 0;

    for (int i = 0; i < length; i++) {
        char ch = data[i];

        if (ch == '(') {
            insideParentheses = true;
            if (tempSegmentSize != 0) {
                maxSegment = std::max(maxSegment, tempSegmentSize);
                tempSegmentSize = 0;
            }
        }
        if (ch == ')') {
            insideParentheses = false;
        }

        if (insideParentheses) {
            if (ch != '_' && ch != '(' && ch != ')') {
                wordsCount++;
            }
        } else {
            if (ch != '_' && ch != '(' && ch != ')') {
                segmentSize++;
                if (i == length - 1) {
                    maxSegment = std::max(maxSegment, segmentSize);
                }
            } else {
                if (segmentSize != 0) {
                    maxSegment = std::max(maxSegment, segmentSize);
                    segmentSize = 0;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    std::cout << maxSegment << " " << wordsCount << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
